confidence_rationale: Every artefact produced a workbook row with a real source_req_id and a verification cell, all three new requirements have traceability rows, and re-running the RTM checker at build scope produced 0 orphans attributable to this step (the HIGH conditions largely hold). Held to MEDIUM rather than HIGH for two reasons this pass cannot resolve itself: the step's central open item, the Priority VALUE mapping (D-M4S03-03), is an unconfirmed placeholder carried to the M4 gate exactly like two prior M4 steps' placeholders, and F-38's skill gap (D-M4S03-01) is closed at the artefact only — the durable fix (a Create-triggered FlowTest example and a Create-to-Initial-only checker rule in flow/record-triggered-flow-patterns) is still pending, unlike this build's three prior flywheel entries which all cite a closing commit.
